questions.stem: What is the most important step to prevent the spread of dengue in a community?
questions.solution: Using mosquito repellents is the most important step to prevent the spread of dengue because dengue is transmitted by mosquitoes. Drinking clean water and maintaining hygiene are important, but they are not the primary preventive measure. Wearing masks is not relevant for dengue prevention.

hi.stem: एक समुदाय में डेंगू के प्रसार को रोकने का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण कदम क्या है?
hi.solution: मच्छर प्रतिकारक का उपयोग करना डेंगू के प्रसार को रोकने का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण कदम है क्योंकि डेंगू मच्छरों द्वारा फैलता है। स्वच्छ पानी पीना और हाइजीन बनाए रखना महत्वपूर्ण है, लेकिन वे प्राथमिक रोकथाम के उपाय नहीं हैं। मास्क पहनना डेंगू रोकथाम के लिए असंबंधित है।
hi.critique: Translation accurately preserves meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi curriculum, and the correct answer remains in the same position.

mr.solution: मच्छर विरोधी द्रव्यांचा वापर करणे हा डेंग्यूच्या पसरणीला रोखण्यासाठी सर्वात महत्वाचा टप्पा आहे कारण डेंग्यू मच्छरांद्वारे पसरतो. स्वच्छ पाणी पिणे आणि हायजीन ठेवणे महत्वाचे आहे, परंतु ते प्राथमिक रोख उपाय नाहीत. मास्क घालणे डेंग्यू रोखण्यासाठी संबंधित नाही.

questions.stem: What is the most effective way to prevent the spread of diseases like typhoid?
choices: Wearing a mask in crowded places
Avoiding close contact with infected people
Drinking boiled water and eating cooked food
questions.solution: Drinking boiled water and eating cooked food is the most effective way to prevent typhoid, as it is caused by bacteria that spread through contaminated food and water. Wearing a mask and getting vaccinated are useful for air-borne diseases, while avoiding close contact is for diseases that spread through direct contact.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for the spread of flu in a school during an outbreak?
questions.solution: Poor hygiene is the main reason for the spread of flu in a school during an outbreak because flu is a communicable disease that spreads through droplets from coughing and sneezing. Overcrowding and sharing personal items may contribute, but poor hygiene is the primary factor. Contaminated water is not the main cause of flu.

hi.stem: एक बाधा के दौरान स्कूल में फ्लू के फैलाव का मुख्य कारण क्या है?

questions.stem: What should be the first action taken if someone in the class starts showing symptoms of the flu?
questions.solution: Isolating the person is the first action to prevent the spread of flu in the class. Giving medicine or calling a doctor may follow, but isolation is the most immediate step. Notifying the school authorities is also important but not the first action.

questions.stem: If a person is infected with a virus like the flu, what is the correct approach to treat the infection?
questions.solution: Rest and drink fluids is the correct approach to treat a viral infection like the flu because antibiotics are ineffective against viruses. Vaccination is a preventive measure, not a treatment. Avoiding all physical activity is not necessary in most cases.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to prevent the spread of antibiotic-resistant bacteria?
choices: Using antibiotics only when prescribed by a doctor
questions.solution: Using antibiotics only when prescribed by a doctor ensures they are used appropriately, which helps prevent the development of resistant bacteria. Taking antibiotics for viral infections is ineffective because antibiotics target bacteria, not viruses. Avoiding all antibiotics is not advisable as they are necessary for treating bacterial infections when needed. Using high doses of antibiotics can increase the risk of resistance and harm the body.

questions.stem: Why is it important to avoid sharing personal items like towels and handkerchiefs?
choices: To prevent the spread of air-borne diseases
To avoid direct contact with pathogens
To reduce the risk of non-communicable diseases
questions.solution: Avoiding sharing personal items like towels and handkerchiefs is important to prevent direct contact with pathogens, which can cause communicable diseases. It is not directly related to air-borne, non-communicable, or insect-borne diseases.
